digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and performance optimization
propositions: Partial-clone fixtures consume 32.69 worker-phase seconds due to >100MiB object duplication per xdist worker
Test cases vary in repository-size dependency: protocol negotiation, missing-object, and reconvergence oracles are size-independent while full-versus-blobless pack guards require the large contrast
Mutable Git servers shared across concurrent workers introduce race conditions and cross-worker contamination; isolated ephemeral per-test fixtures are required
Splitting into one retained large-object guard (141+ MiB) and small isolated fixtures (1 KiB) for size-independent cases reduces pytest wall time by 69.5% and setup cost by 85.2%
No maintained OSS consensus supports shared mutable state across parallel workers; git/git, jelmer/dulwich, and eclipse-jgit/jgit all use isolated ephemeral daemon instances with explicit teardown
